The product

IntervieHire is an AI-driven hiring platform. Recruiters author interview blueprints and grading rubrics, candidates complete AI-led interviews, and the platform returns structured evaluations.

My work focused on the real-time interview infrastructure: making the voice pipeline more controllable, reducing its cost, and keeping distributed sessions consistent.

Rebuilding the voice pipeline

I migrated interviews from Vapi to a self-hosted LiveKit Agents pipeline, combining Deepgram speech-to-text, Silero voice activity detection, Cartesia text-to-speech, and Fastify.

VOICE PIPELINE

Candidate audio→Silero VAD + Deepgram→Interview engine→Cartesia speech
LiveKit carries the real-time session. Fastify and WebSockets coordinate session state, transcripts, and responses.

Keeping the session authoritative

A live interview is more than audio moving in two directions. Session state, turn timing, transcripts, and AI responses all need a consistent source of truth.

  • Engineered WebSocket-based bidirectional session orchestration for low-latency transcript and AI-response streaming.
  • Implemented server-authoritative timing and idempotent interview turns to keep session progression consistent.
  • Hardened distributed deployments across Railway and Vercel and migrated interview media storage to Backblaze B2.

Outcome

The migration reduced voice infrastructure cost by 58%+ while giving the team more control over real-time interview orchestration.
